title: Glowing balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='balloonGlow' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb3d9'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#ff4da6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c2185b'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='shine' cx='35%' cy='30%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff' stop-opacity='0.85'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffffff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='stringGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe082'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb300'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='34' ry='38' fill='#ff4da6' opacity='0.15'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='26' ry='30' fill='#ff80c0' opacity='0.12'/>

  <!-- balloon body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='24' ry='28' fill='url(#balloonGlow)'/>

  <!-- lighter edge to define shape -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='23' ry='27' fill='none' stroke='#ff85c8' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- highlight shine -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='28' rx='9' ry='12' fill='url(#shine)'/>

  <!-- small secondary shine -->
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='22' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- balloon knot -->
  <polygon points='46,65 54,65 51,71 49,71' fill='#d81b60'/>
  <polygon points='46,65 50,65 50,70 46,65' fill='#ff4da6' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- string -->
  <path d='M50,71 Q54,78 48,84 Q43,90 47,97' fill='none' stroke='url(#stringGrad)' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
